تعترضي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَرِضِي (taʕtariḍī) /taʕ.ta.ri.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# تُعْتَرَضِي (tuʕtaraḍī) /tuʕ.ta.ra.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
